Bittu Mahima Puran

Ek mahaan jeevan ka praamaanik itihaas. Itna praamaanik ki koi praman nahi mila.

Abhilekh Sankhya: BTU/108/∞Vargikaran: Atyant Gopniya (sab jaante hain)Sthiti: Jaanch jaari, nateeja nahi
  1. Pratham Adhyay: Janm

    Ek saadharan ghar, ek asaadharan aafat

    Jyotishiyon ne kundli dekhkar kaha tha ki yeh baalak itihaas rachega. Itihaas ne baad mein spashtikaran diya ki uska matlab “itihaas mein shikayat darj karega” tha.

    “Bittu ka janm ek saadharan parivaar mein hua tha, par uski harkatein asadharan thi.”
  2. Dwitiya Adhyay: Baalyakaal

    Jab baaki bachche padh rahe the

    Gurukul ke abhilekh batate hain ki Bittu kaksha mein sabse pehle pahunchne ka sapna dekhte the. Sapna isliye, kyunki woh us samay so rahe the.

    “Jab duniya so rahi thi, Bittu bhi so raha tha.”
  3. Tritiya Adhyay: Shiksha aur Shodh

    Aryabhata ke baad sabse bada khoj-karta

    Bittu ne gahan shodh ke baad yeh khoj nikala ki π ka maan lagbhag 3.14 hai. Shodh-patra jama karne gaye to pata chala ki yeh khoj kuch 1500 saal pehle ho chuki thi. Bittu ne ise “parallel discovery” ghoshit kiya.

    “Jahan logic khatam hota hai, wahan se Bittu shuru hota hai.”
  4. Chaturth Adhyay: Gyan Prapti

    Atma-chintan ka ek lamba daur

    Bittu ne himalaya jaane ka nirnay liya, par Google Maps ne route dikhane se mana kar diya. Unhone wahin kamre mein baithkar dhyaan lagaya aur 11 minute mein moksh tatha neend dono prapt kiye.

    “Bittu ko samajhna aasaan nahi, kyunki usne khud ko kabhi samjha hi nahi.”
  5. Pancham Adhyay: Vartamaan Kaal

    Ek jeevit kimvadanti, lagbhag late

    Aaj Bittu Maharaj rashtra ki sewa mein sakriya hain, aur rashtra unke prati dhairya rakhne mein. Har baithak mein woh “bas paanch minute” mein pahunchne wale hain.

    “Itihaas gawah hai, Bittu kabhi kisi kaam mein samay par nahi pahuncha.” “Ek baar Bittu ne chup rehne ka faisla kiya tha. Woh din aaj tak nahi aaya.”
